title: Magnet
description: A button with gravity: it leans toward the cursor, then springs home when the cursor leaves.
usage: Wrap the one control a hero lives or dies by — the call to action, the play button. The pull is a fraction of the distance (about a third), the return is a spring, and touch devices simply never feel it, which is correct: there is no cursor to lean toward.
a11y: Motion only: the control’s position in the layout, its focus order and its name never change, and keyboard focus does not trigger the pull. Under prefers-reduced-motion the magnet is switched off and the button sits still like its ancestors.
